about: Every fault a reader, an owner or an audit found in a generated picture, as a named class. A class is closed only when it has a prevention (a spec rule or prompt clause), a detection (a question or rubric check) and a regression (a contract-test section that keeps catching it), and its prevention has not been measured to fail. Proposed by the rangsarn session; rainmojo-so and rangsarn each keep their own copy, in step, and run apart.
status_rule: closed when prevention, detection and regression are all non-empty and prevention_effective is not false; otherwise open

classes.symptom: Two or more people in one scene share a face, hair, skin and pose.
classes.cause: Near-identical appearance text, the generator's one canonical face for a demographic, attribute leakage between adjacent subjects.
prevention: prompt clause: every person has a face, a build and an age of their own
variation on a subject with count > 1

classes.symptom: Repeated objects are one image pasted: baskets, fruit, tents, shelf stock.
classes.cause: One description for a count above one draws that many copies.
classes.found_by: owner, rangsarn run 03; rainmojo-so sweep scene 10 (tents)
prevention: matched for a set alike by design

classes.symptom: Containers hold the wrong contents while their count is right.
classes.cause: Contents named in the object's name rode along in the count question.
prevention: listed_contents splits the name across a count above one

classes.symptom: Lettering-like marks that are no real script, on packaging, signs, pages and diagrams.
classes.cause: text_in_image none makes the model fill text-bearing surfaces with half-formed glyphs.
classes.note: The prevention does not prevent: generate the label area plain and composite real text, as headlines are, is the open fix.

classes.symptom: Legible text, numbers or logos the brief did not ask for.
classes.cause: Text-bearing surfaces invite lettering; digits are what the model draws best.
prevention: prompt clause that lettering sits small and soft
classes.note: 10 of 16 images carried text despite the clause.

classes.symptom: More people than declared, or people in a scene declared empty.
classes.cause: A purpose sentence describing a human action outweighs an empty subject list; counts only ever asked about declared entities.
prevention: PERSON_IMPLIED_RE warning, quoting the word that fired

classes.symptom: Things outside the depth of field are drawn sharp.
classes.cause: Image models draw everything sharp whatever the aperture says.
classes.found_by: rainmojo-so sweep (5 misses), rangsarn runs 01 to 03
prevention: prompt names what lies outside the focus
classes.note: Open on the generation side: a blur from a depth map after generation.

classes.symptom: A second visible light source, or a reviewer counting the declared fill as one.
classes.cause: The light question did not know about the declared fill.

classes.symptom: Apparent sizes do not follow distance: two fighters 1.22 apart drawn 1.05 apart.
classes.cause: A model cannot act on a ratio; it draws its own prior.
prevention: prompt states which is nearer and larger, in words
classes.note: Delivered ratios were measured wrong in both ringside images.

classes.symptom: An object with no visible support.
classes.cause: Nothing in the brief said what holds it.

classes.symptom: Extra, missing or fused fingers, or fingers bending the wrong way.
classes.cause: Anatomy the generator gets wrong most often.
classes.found_by: rainmojo-so sweep; rangsarn run 01 (question defect on grips)
prevention: hands field, atomic and separate from the action

classes.symptom: People and things on different surfaces drawn on one floor, or one floor drawn as several.
classes.cause: A raised landing, stage or ring left at the camera's floor in the brief.
prevention: warning for a person on a raised declared thing at height 0

classes.symptom: A nose rendered large against the ears, the close wide-angle portrait.
classes.cause: A face nearer the camera than perspective allows.
classes.found_by: module design, corrected by the lite session
prevention: face distance floor, 0.9 m on any lens, longer on 20 and 28 mm

classes.symptom: A subject past the third line, or a crop that loses the key thing.
A background filled with one repeated box in uniform rows, too many and too even for a real shop.
classes.cause: The brief says 'boxed stock' and nothing about how the real kind of place is organised.
classes.note: Open: an evidence brief on how the real kind of place is zoned, written into locale_details, is the proposed prevention.

classes.symptom: Any fault no question above asks about.
classes.cause: A fixed question set only finds failures someone thought of.
classes.note: A meta class. Every true answer to q_anomalies becomes a class of its own.
